title: Controversy: sources disagree, and an unambiguous exclusion (SYNTHETIC)
author_note: Author-made. Step 1 is the disagreement case: correct output is 'sources disagree' and escalation. Step 2 is the exclusion case; it rests on Article 2 of the official English text of the federal personal data decree-law (U01EN).

steps.text: Step 1. The FHBS relies on a federal once-only policy to justify pulling a resident's records from the DPRO. The DPRO relies on the Dubai exchange rules and says consent must come first. Both ask for a ruling.
Step 2. The FHBS asks whether the federal personal data law's right to object to automated decisions covers its eligibility pre-check.

hidden.expected_candidate: SCOPE_FINDING: instrument does not apply, per Article 2
